FuseSoC support

UVVM includes FuseSoC core files for all sub-libraries. To use UVVM as a dependency in a FuseSoC project, add it as a library and depend on uvvm:uvvm:uvvm (the aggregate of all sub-libraries).

To run UVVM’s own demo testbenches with GHDL:

fusesoc run --target=sim uvvm:uvvm:bitvis_irqc

A sim target is available for the demo testbenches of bitvis_irqc, bitvis_uart, bitvis_vip_error_injection, bitvis_vip_ethernet, bitvis_vip_uart and uvvm_assertions. The demo testbenches of bitvis_vip_scoreboard and uvvm_util have no FuseSoC target, since they depend on VIPs that in turn depend on these libraries, and FuseSoC does not allow circular dependencies between cores. The bitvis_vip_spec_cov demos have no target either, since they also need the run_spec_cov.py post-processing step.

On Windows:

  • The GHDL backend in Edalize needs make on the PATH, e.g. from MSYS2.

  • FuseSoC copies the shared td_* files to long build paths. If a path exceeds the 260 character limit of Windows, FuseSoC fails with Could not find EDA API file "None". Use a short checkout path or a short build directory, e.g. fusesoc run --build-root C:/build --target=sim uvvm:uvvm:bitvis_irqc.

The .core files are generated from compile_order.txt and VERSION.TXT metadata by script/generate_fusesoc_cores.py. Regenerate after changing either:

uv run script/generate_fusesoc_cores.py

Tests for the generator:

python3 script/test_generate_fusesoc_cores.py
